episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A gunfight, a race for their lives... it's all happening for London cops and best mates Bishop and Pike as a notorious criminal shows up out of the blue.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Thrown off the Sharp case, Pike decides to break the rules. A new chase leads the boys into a shoot-out.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Pike and Bishop's refusal to follow orders hurls them into a disturbing case.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A delivery rocks Bishop to his core. Pike puts his family first, but it means abandoning his best mate.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Brace yourself for a car chase, a hostage crisis and a prison break as Pike and Bishop are thrown into a dangerous race for answers.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A chance discovery propels Bishop and Pike deep undercover, and they soon find themselves at the heart of a notorious international crime family.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tension mounts as Pike and Bishop are drawn deeper into the Markides family. Tanner sweats over her recent decision.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The hunt for a missing girl leads Bishop and Pike to Amsterdam and into the heart of the Markides's dark operations.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Alex regains control of the family, Mikey puts Bishop and Pike in charge of a gun-trafficking op. But the boys quickly find themselves out of their depth.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Elena digs into Bishop's identity. Meanwhile, the boys hunt for a lead in Cyprus. But how long can they keep their cover?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Bishop and Pike's covers are blown, with serious consequences for the unit. With the boys' lives at stake, Tanner goes head-to-head with Elena.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Bishop seeks out one last chance to bring the Markides family down. But this time, Pike isn't prepared to help him.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The unit must go off-the-books if they're to take down Alex and Mikey.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Pike and Bishop escape London for a much-deserved break in South Africa, but the fun does not last as they are drawn into a new case.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Pike and Bishop's trip to Cape Town takes a turn when they are sent to Msitu prison, a run-down, secure fortress with huge iron gates and impenetrable walls. Meanwhile, Arjana does her best to get them out, and a good Samaritan helps pick up a lead on the kidnapper.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The police lay siege to the kidnappers, but something doesn't sit right with Bishop.
